summary: Positions 150-299 (sheets 18-37). Haiku: 15 photo, 17 unsure, 118 skip. Of the 15 photo entries: 15 keep_ok (4 with small field fixes: Bolshoy Dom spelling, Palau Nacional year optional, Perelman and Tsiolkovsky architect lists), 0 keep_wrong, 4 main-photo problems (London Coliseum, Waldemarsudde, Perelman minor, Estonia Theatre no usable current exterior). None of the 150 is on the wall by qid, id or name. Rescued 16: 6 of the 17 unsure (House on the Embankment, Aland Maritime Museum, Museum of Contemporary Art Zagreb, Bush House, North Macedonia museum, Ohara Museum) and 10 of the 118 skips (Yamato Bunkakan, Urasoe, Lisinski, Janacek, De Doelen, Palacio de Congresos, Siida, Jewish Museum Munich, Waino Aaltonen Museum, Royal Armouries). Strongest rescues: Jewish Museum Munich, Museum of Contemporary Art Zagreb, Yamato Bunkakan, Urasoe, Royal Armouries, Ohara, Siida (photo caveat). Borderline: Janacek, De Doelen, Palacio de Congresos, Aland, North Macedonia. The other 11 unsure stay unsure or skip because no photo shows the building (Mirador del Rio, Cankar Hall, Museum for Communication, Verkhovna Rada, De Kuip, Capitol Visitor Center, Theater St. Gallen) or the building is a district or replica ensemble (Betondorp, Poble Espanyol) or the architect is not the building's (Virginia Museum, Gaudi House Museum). Most of the remaining skips are correct: ordinary theatres, capitols, towers, stadiums and collection-led museums.
